name: H2-SQRT: an O_h-equivariant hierarchical (H2) square-root neural operator for the TPMS interface Schur complement
one_paragraph: Make the one representation that has passed the +-3% gate on the real teacher (hierarchical low rank of the reference factor at 13.9-15.6% of dense on four seats, 1344 near-field + 2965 admissible blocks, leaf 64 [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]) the learned output, with four changes forced by the facts: the learned object is a symmetric H2-matrix Rhat approximating the unique SPD square root A^{1/2} (Shat = Z Rhat^2 Z with Z the rigid-mode projector: PSD and rigid-invariant by construction, gauge-free, exactly cube-group-equivariant via frame averaging, multiplicative error unamplified by cond(A) = 7.2e4 [METRIC]); far-field blocks use fixed ranks per level with nested cluster bases whose leading six columns are the analytic rigid modes and whose 6x6 rigid-rigid couplings, the precision-critical smooth far-field content behind the 1e3-1e4 near/far cancellation [STRUCTURE OF S], get a dedicated high-precision head; every emitted number is O(1) in a compliance-scaled gauge (R^2 0.98 local predictability [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]); and all supervision is on gauge-free actions and products with a whitened bulk loss plus a two-sided, detached-Ritz extreme-mode loss (D/d and every averaged loss mislead by ~100x [METRIC]). Because the current GP teacher is discontinuous in geometry (+0.01% thickness moves one direction 59.8% [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]), labels are regenerated with a C1-blended aggregation stabilisation (~9 h on 64 cores per 1024 geometries), all 1024 packets are factored (1024 -> 8192 geometries, +256 CUT seats), and the contract is the module-level Loewner sandwich that composes exactly to any lattice, deployed in mode A inside a trust-region-managed TO loop. The plan is front-loaded with oracle tests (fixed-rank H2 of A^{1/2}, near/far coherence budgets, gamma sweep, interpolability) so that the prior is falsified within two weeks if the required far-field precision (~1e-4 relative on the leading couplings) is out of reach, with an explicit fallback to a computed principal part plus learned multiplicative correction.
representation: Rhat: a symmetric H2-matrix on the full trace (q dofs, 3k-47.8k across the 1024 geometries) over a fixed background-grid octree of the six cube faces (leaf 64, admissibility min(diam) <= 2 dist, the tree/admissibility that passed +-3% at 14.95% of dense on 0328 and 13.9-15.6% on four seats [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]; leaves with too few active dofs merged upward by a deterministic rule on the exact active mask). Deployed operator Shat = Z Rhat^2 Z, Z the orthogonal projector onto the complement of the six rigid modes; evaluation on the quotient Ahat = B Shat B^T with the existing evaluator. Properties by construction: PSD for any Rhat (x^T Rhat^2 x = ||Rhat x||^2); exact rigid null space (the 38.8% diagonal-only attractor disappeared only with rigid invariance by construction [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]); the label A^{1/2} is the unique SPD square root, hence canonical, gauge-free, continuous in A and P_g-equivariant, whereas a Cholesky factor depends on a node ordering no permutation group preserves. Error model: Rhat = A^{1/2} + F gives whitened M = (I+Delta)(I+Delta^T), Delta = A^{-1/2} F, eps_op ~ 2||Delta||: left-multiplicative error unamplified, additive factor error amplified by at most sqrt(cond) = 269 (111 measured for entry-relative noise), never by cond(A) = 7.2e4 [METRIC][ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS]. Blocks: near-field dense 3x3-per-node-pair blocks (~5.5M numbers at d = 12,792); far-field blocks U_s C_st U_t^T with nested cluster bases (H2 transfer matrices, O(N r) storage), C_ts = C_st^T, fixed ranks per level set a priori from the Stage-0 oracle (working assumption r = 32 at leaf level to 16 at the top; top-8 singular values carry >= 99.5% of far face-face block energy, adaptive average ~18 at +-3% [STRUCTURE OF S]); the leading six columns of every basis are the cluster's analytic rigid-body modes (Saint-Venant resultants), fixed and gauge-free; the 6x6 rigid-rigid sub-block of each coupling is the precision-critical smooth far-field content (must cohere with the near field to ~1e-4 on the factor; tails may be loose at ~1e-2; banding the true factor fails at every radius because of the 1e3-1e4 near/far cancellation [STRUCTURE OF S]). Gauge: Rhat_ij = exp((s_i+s_j)/2) r_ij with s the per-dof log compliance scale (R^2 0.98 local predictability, leave-one-seat-out spread 16.8 [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]), so every emitted number is O(1). Optional two-sided soft-subspace correction Rhat <- Rhat + W E W^T (k = 256, E symmetric). Budget <= 20% of dense per cell (~16M numbers, ~130 MB fp64), H2-matvec ~3e7 flops.
teacher_and_data: Teacher: the frozen CutFEM Q2 ghost-penalty pipeline (gamma = eta = 1e-4; 0328: 231,192 dofs, q = 12,798, 31.85 s condensation on 64 cores [GOAL]) is kept for Stage 0 but its labels are discontinuous in geometry (+0.01% thickness -> one 1.1e-6 direction +59.8% via a 5.6e-15 volume-fraction cell and 3 new GP faces; central differences disagree 87%; hard-classifier prototype flips to mu_max 1.25 on a 1e-12 threshold shift [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]); a directly learned continuous surrogate cannot pass +-3% near any of the ~1e-4-spaced events. Stage 1 regenerates all labels with a C1-blended aggregation stabilisation at the frozen commit [TOOLS AVAILABLE]: aggregation/ghost weights beta(v) = beta0 (1 - w(v)) with w a C1 ramp in cut-cell volume fraction on [0, v0], island components deleted, face penalties scaled by w(v_min); every term PSD so Loewner monotonicity is preserved. Acceptance of the new teacher: Tet10 compliance agreement within 0.05-0.10% [ASSEMBLY / DELIVERABLE], whitened central differences at h = 1e-4 and 1e-3 agree to O(h^2), no direction below the FP64 floor (storage-floor tool), the ~6 fragment modes gone; cost ~9 h on 64 cores per 1024 geometries. The exact discrete state (active-cell mask, GP-face graph, volume fractions, support measures) is always a network input. Labels: A^{1/2} by fp64 eigendecomposition (2e12 flops, tens of seconds per seat on a GPU) for all 1024 packets, not 33 [GOAL]; L* = chol(A) for whitening, fp32, streamed; H2-projected block labels of A^{1/2} on the fixed tree; rigid-rigid coupling labels P_s^T A^{1/2}_st P_t (unique, continuous). Volume: 1024 -> 8192 geometries (~3 days on 64 cores) covering the TO design range in the 8+4 parameters, plus 256 CUT-through-boundary seats (none exist today [GOAL]). The 48 exact cube-group images serve as training frames and as an equivariance test. Splits registered; holdout never used for screening.
architecture: Encoder: 3D U-Net on the 65^3 background grid (11 analytic fields, level-set gradient, active-cell and GP-face masks, volume fraction, support measure, node mask; five levels, 32 -> 256 channels; attention over the 5^3 coarsest grid for global mixing, since opposite-face coupling through the sheet is global and V1's receptive radius 0.23 could not represent a 1e3-1e4 cancellation [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]); ~5M parameters, bf16 trunk. Exact O_h-equivariance by frame averaging, Rhat = (1/48) sum_g P_g^T Rhat_theta(g.geom) P_g (average of symmetric matrices, PSD preserved): four random frames per training step, all 48 batched at inference; a steerable group-conv encoder is a later efficiency upgrade. Features: per-node phi_i in R^96 gathered at trace nodes; cluster features at every octree level by attention pooling over active nodes; one global context vector. Heads (weight-shared, O(1) outputs in the scaled gauge): scale head s_i pretrained on the compliance regression; near-field head emitting 3x3 blocks per node pair within near-field leaf pairs from (phi_i, phi_j, x_i - x_j, face normals), symmetric by construction; basis head U_s = qr+([rigid modes | MLP(phi) columns]) with positive-diagonal QR fixing the gauge, plus level transfer matrices; coupling head C_st from pooled features of s and t, relative position/orientation and global context, with the rigid-rigid 6x6 sub-block from a separate high-precision residual head; optional soft-subspace head (Stage 5) Rhat <- Rhat + W E W^T, two-sided by construction (the old rank-512 M could only soften; its L's had lambda_min(H0) = 0.02-0.13 [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED c]). Assembly in fp64 (H2-matvec ~3e7 flops); Ahat never formed except for audits; inference <= 1 s per cell on one GPU including 48 frames, ~130 MB fp64 per cell.
loss_and_training: All training signals are functions of Ahat's action on a labelled seat, whitened by L* (M = L*^{-1} Ahat L*^{-T}, same spectrum as the evaluator's R*^{-T} Ahat R*^{-1}). Bulk: whitened Frobenius (1/d)||M - I||_F^2 via Hutchinson with 32 probes enriched by the seat's 64 softest eigenvectors; an upper bound on eps_op conservative by at most sqrt(d) = 113. D/d is a diagnostic only (1.27e-5 coexisted with eps_op 0.229, three deciding modes [METRIC]). Tail: two-sided log-symmetric hinge sum max(0, |log mu_k| - log(1+eps))^2 over the 32 lowest and 32 highest Ritz values of M from warm-started block Lanczos (two iterations per step, full restart every 100 steps), Ritz vectors detached, gradients by Hellmann-Feynman through one H2-matvec per mode; curriculum eps 0.5 -> 0.3 -> 0.1 -> 0.03; two-sided because a one-sided term traded mu_max 15 -> 5 for mu_min 0.13 -> 0.05 [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]. Certified monitor: Schatten-32 Hutchinson estimate (<= 1.34 ||M - I||_2) every 20 steps; exact fp64 eigendecomposition on dev seats every epoch is the only number reported as eps_op. Pretraining (local, gauge-free): near-field blocks and far-field products U C U^T against the H2-projected blocks of A^{1/2}, entries scaled by exp(-(s_i+s_j)/2), nested Eckart-Young ordering of learned basis columns. Precision: bf16 trunk, fp32 heads, fp64 assembly/whitening/Lanczos (fp32 x cond(A) = 4.3e-3 is marginal for any additive formation). Optimiser: AdamW, then Gauss-Newton/K-FAC fine-tune of the heads (Newton with column scaling converged where raw Adam produced NaNs [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]). Cost ~1 s per (seat, frame) step; a full run on 1024 seats ~20-30 GPU-days.
acceptance_and_deployment: Contract: module-level Loewner sandwich eps_op = max|mu - 1| <= 0.10 (work) / 0.03 (target) on held-out seats, reported with the number of modes outside each gate and their physical/stabilisation classification. It composes exactly: per-cell (1-eps)S_c <= Shat_c <= (1+eps)S_c gives (1-eps)K <= Khat <= (1+eps)K for any lattice, load and design, compliance within ~+-eps and energy-norm displacement error <= eps/(1-eps); the measured 0.31% compliance error at eps_op 0.152 was alignment luck and is not relied on [ASSEMBLY / DELIVERABLE]. If the Stage-0 gamma sweep shows the deciding modes are stabilisation-defined, the contract is registered as a shifted-whitening sandwich on (A + cE) with c fixed by the sweep [OPEN DECISIONS 1]. Secondary registered task suite: heterogeneous 2-cell, 2x2x2, 4x4x4 assemblies, non-self-equilibrated loads, compliance, energy-norm displacement, finite-difference and adjoint end-load compliance sensitivities against the teacher's stable derivative (0.023%), sensitivities expected ~10x more sensitive than compliance. Deployment mode A [OPEN DECISIONS 2]: Shat = Z Rhat^2 Z in H2 form (~130 MB fp64, <= 1 s per cell on one GPU vs 31.85 s x 64 cores), assembled by cell actions, lattice solved by PCG; the TO loop is trust-region managed with teacher evaluations on a sparse subset of cells every k iterations restoring first-order consistency (the only convergence guarantee for a biased surrogate). No inference-time interior solve on the primary path [OPEN DECISIONS 3]. Mode B kept only as a diagnostic (PCG iteration count is a cheap monotone proxy of eps_op); its true-action cost is the elimination being avoided. Equivariance verified numerically (P_g Ahat P_g^T vs Ahat(g.geom) to fp64 roundoff).
staged_plan: Stage 0, oracle and label audit (2 weeks; ~25 teacher runs ~15 min on 64 cores; 2 GPU-days). (a) Fixed-rank, fixed-octree H2 oracle of A^{1/2} on the 4 factored seats plus 12 newly factored: pass = +-3% at <= 20% of dense and +-10% at <= 15%. (b) Coherence oracle: perturb the passing factor's near field, far-field rigid-rigid couplings and far-field tails by independent smooth relative fields at 1e-2/1e-3/1e-4 -> precision budgets b_near, b_lead, b_tail for eps_op <= 0.10 and <= 0.03. (c) Gamma sweep on 0328 (1e-3, 1e-5) plus the thickness-exponent test (membrane at 1+delta, bending at (1+delta)^3): which modes decide and whether they are physics. (d) Interpolability: nine teacher runs along the thickness path at spacings 1e-3/1e-2/1e-1, eps_op of the endpoint-averaged factor at midpoints, activation events counted. (e) Factor all 1024 packets; cross-seat Thompson distances in the common ordering.

Stage 1, continuous labels (2 weeks; 9 h x 64 cores per 1024 geometries). Implement the C1-blended aggregation stabilisation at the frozen commit. Falsifiable outcome: Tet10 within 0.10%, whitened central differences at h = 1e-4 and 1e-3 agree to O(h^2), the ideal interpolant at spacing 1e-2 passes +-10%, no new near-floor directions. Then regenerate 1024, extend to 8192 (~3 days on 64 cores), add 256 CUT seats.

Stage 2, fit without geometry (3 GPU-days). Free H2 parameters on 0328 trained with bulk + tail loss from the oracle truncation and from a scaled random start. Outcome: <= 0.03 held from the oracle start and <= 0.10 from scratch within 5k steps; settles whether the Newton dense fit's 0.047 was a loss ceiling; yields the residual model of a fitted H2 factor.

Stage 3, one-seat neural memorisation (2 weeks). Full network on 0328 x 48 frames. Outcome: train eps_op <= 0.10, the first neural pass on any seat (best so far ~4; V1 never memorised its training seats); the measured residual (entry-relative / block-coherent / soft-aligned) replaces the 100x uncertainty in the per-entry budget.

Stage 4, generalisation and learning curve (6 weeks; ~30 GPU-days). Train on 24 / 768 / 6144 seats, dev 8 / 128 / 512. Outcome: dev eps_op <= 0.3 at 33, <= 0.10 at 1024, <= 0.03 at 8192 with a decreasing curve. Ablations: frame averaging vs augmentation; analytic vs learned leading bases; enriched vs plain probes.
Stage 5, soft-subspace correction head (2 weeks). Outcome: modes outside +-3% on dev <= 10 and dev eps_op improved >= 2x; otherwise dropped.

Stage 6, assembly, sensitivities, TO (3 weeks). Heterogeneous lattices (untested even for the teacher), adjoint and finite-difference sensitivities, trust-region mini-TO on a 4x4x4 lattice against a teacher run. Outcome: sensitivity error <= 3x the Loewner compliance bound and the same primary load paths as the teacher design.
Stage 7, CUT cells, throughput, release (4 weeks). 256 CUT seats trained and evaluated; inference <= 1 s per cell; certificate tool (whitened spectrum, mode counts, classification) shipped.

Fallback branch (outside the prior; triggered by K2 or K6): principal-part design in which a coarse interior model (fine collar plus shell-kinematic or Q2 core, 1-3 s per cell) supplies the leading far-field couplings exactly and the same H2 network learns only a multiplicative correction (I + Delta); encoder, loss, contract and data carry over unchanged.
kill_criteria: K1: Stage 0a fixed-rank H2 oracle of A^{1/2} needs > 30% of dense for +-3% or cannot pass +-10% at any budget (then revert to an H-Cholesky in octree post-order with per-frame labels, or kill the H2 route if that also fails).

K2: Stage 0b coherence oracle gives b_lead < 1e-4, i.e. the leading far-field couplings must be better than 1e-4 relative for +-10%; regression cannot deliver that, so the direct-learning route is precision-limited before training and the fallback (computed principal part + learned multiplicative correction) is triggered.

K3: no continuous stabilisation keeps the Tet10 validation within 0.10% and the whitened Lipschitz constant of geometry -> S below ~10 per unit relative thickness; the module contract is then unattainable by any continuous surrogate and the programme moves to a task-level or stiffness-floored contract.

K4: Stage 2 free H2 fit cannot hold eps_op <= 0.03 from the oracle start or reach <= 0.10 from scratch within 5k steps: the loss/optimiser cannot reach the deciding modes even with unlimited capacity.
K5: Stage 3 cannot memorise one seat to eps_op <= 0.3 with >= 5M parameters and 20k steps.
K6: the Stage-4 dev learning curve is flat between 33 and 1024 seats, or dev eps_op exceeds 0.3 at 1024, or exceeds 0.10 at 8192 seats.
K7: Stage 6 sensitivity error > 10x the Loewner compliance bound, or the trust-region mini-TO diverges from the teacher's design at +-10% modules (contract or deployment mode must change).
K8: inference slower than the teacher's 31.85 s wall-clock per cell or storage > 300 MB per cell.
what_it_discards_from_current_assets: Discarded from the critical path: the banded-L + low-rank-M backend (superelement/neural_schur/backend.py, fit.py) and its fixed-L reachability criterion (factor_fit/reachability.py); the T^T D T lifting layers with their closed-form block-diagonal oracle, lifting-layer inverse and 22x sparse gradient (neural_schur/oracle.py, test_lift.py), all reachability-limited by 37-600x [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED c,d]; the V1/V1G six-face CNN and its 54-channel face-image input (v1_superelement.py, run_v1*.sh); the free dense-factor Newton fit as a model (factor_fit/step1_*.py; kept as a diagnostic for Stage 2); the collar + coarse-core pipeline as the primary path (retained only as the fallback branch's principal part); the current GP labels (replaced by continuous-stabilisation labels); the 33-factor limit (all 1024 packets factored, dataset grown to 8192 + 256 CUT); the Cholesky factor on the quotient as the learned object (replaced by the symmetric square root on the full trace with projector Z; the quotient map B is kept for evaluation); augmentation-only symmetry (replaced by exact frame averaging). Kept and reused: the full-spectrum evaluator (neural_schur/evaluator.py, spectrum_eval.py), the hierarchical builder with self-tests (factor_fit/hmat*.py, multiseat.py) as oracle and H2 block-label projector, the assembly harness (factor_fit/assemble*.py), the storage-floor and mode-classification tools (storage_floor.py, floor_modes.py), the per-entry noise and coherence scripts (perentry.py, coher.py), the compliance-scale regression (step2_quotient_scale.py) as the diagonal prior, the teacher rebuild (gp_build.py, gp_launch.py) for label regeneration, and the cube-group permutation code.
key_risks: Precision: ~1e5 smooth global coupling numbers per cell must be predicted to ~1e-4 relative, 10-100x beyond demonstrated operator-learning precision (1e-2..1e-3); mitigated by the Stage-0 budget measurement, analytic leading bases, 8192 geometries and the learning-curve kill, with the principal-part fallback if it fails.

H2-compressibility of A^{1/2} is unmeasured (the Cholesky factor R* costs 15% of dense at +-3%); if the square root is markedly worse, the fallback is an H-Cholesky in octree post-order with 48 per-frame labels and equivariance only at the level of Ahat.

If label regeneration is refused, the GP teacher's discontinuities (59.8% single-direction jumps at 1e-4 relative thickness, events ~1e-4 apart) make the module gate unattainable by any continuous surrogate [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY].

Tail-loss dynamics: spectral whack-a-mole between the two ends, Lanczos missing newly created outliers, gradient noise from detached Ritz vectors; mitigated by the two-sided log-symmetric hinge, Schatten-32 monitor, periodic full restarts and exact per-epoch eigendecompositions.

Data density: ~3 samples per geometry axis at 1024 seats in an 8+4-parameter space; the effective dimension of the coupling map is unknown, and 1e-4 precision by interpolation requires low effective dimension.

Physical validity of the softest modes is validated only through compliance (Tet10 0.05-0.10%); if the gamma sweep shows they are stabilisation-defined, the contract must be floored and the gate's meaning changes.
fp64 throughput and I/O: whitening factors for 1024 seats (~330 MB fp32 each) must be streamed; per-step fp64 Lanczos and assembly must stay O(k) matvecs.
Frame averaging costs 48 encoder passes per cell and the fixed octree meets sparse active clusters at small q (3k); leaf merging must be identical for labels and predictions.
Compliance is first order in the operator error and design sensitivities are untested; a TO optimiser can exploit surrogate error, hence the trust-region loop with periodic teacher checkpoints.
No CUT-through-boundary labels exist; the architecture handles variable traces but any CUT claim waits for the 256 new seats.
literature_basis: A multiscale neural network based on hierarchical matrices (and companion: hierarchical nested bases) - the H2-shaped network with fixed ranks per level that this path turns into an operator/factor emitter.
Neural-HSS: Hierarchical Semi-Separable Neural PDE Solver - fixed-rank hierarchical layer with a sample-count theorem used to size per-seat action supervision.

Existence of H-matrix approximants to the inverse FE-matrix of elliptic operators with L-infinity coefficients; H-matrix approximability of the inverses of FEM matrices - existence of H-factors with exponential convergence in rank (contrast-dependent constants are the caveat).

On the numerical rank of the off-diagonal blocks of Schur complements of discretized elliptic PDEs; Direct Schur complement method by domain decomposition based on H-matrix approximation - rank bounds and H-format precedent for the object being emitted.
Hierarchical interpolative factorization for elliptic operators - gauge-fixed skeleton/ID parameterisation as an alternative basis construction.

Operator SVD with Neural Networks via Nested Low-Rank Approximation; Locally Subspace-Informed Neural Operators for Efficient Multiscale PDE Solving (GMsFEM-NO) - gauge-free product/subspace losses and nested rank ordering.

Learning Adaptive Coarse Spaces Using Transferable Neural Network Models for Linear and Nonlinear Overlapping Domain Decomposition Methods - soft-mode subspace prediction with sign-invariant losses (Stage 5 head).

Elliptic PDE learning is provably data-efficient; Learning elliptic partial differential equations with randomized linear algebra - far-field blocks recoverable from actions; the probe-coverage factor motivates soft-eigenvector-enriched probes.
Factored Sparse Approximate Inverse Preconditioning via Spectral Optimization - detached-Ritz extreme-eigenvalue loss recipe.
Learning Interface Conditions in Domain Decomposition Solvers - max-over-probes spectral loss with a convergence theorem; Frobenius-optimal objects have worse worst-case behaviour.

Spectral Analysis of the Weighted Frobenius Objective; Learning from Linear Algebra (PreCorrector); Neural incomplete factorization (NeuralIF) - why averaged and weighted Frobenius losses miss soft modes; whitened loss as certified upper bound; matvec-only losses.
Message-Passing GNNs Fail to Approximate Sparse Triangular Factorizations - factor entries need hierarchical, not local, information flow.

Geometry-Informed Neural Operator for Large-Scale 3D PDEs (GINO); CubeNet: Equivariance to 3D Rotation and Translation - volumetric geometry encoding with global mixing; cube-group equivariance and its data efficiency.

Choose a Transformer: Fourier or Galerkin; Mitigating spectral bias for the multiscale operator learning (HANO) - low-rank kernels from node features; hierarchical attention with high-frequency-aware losses.

Embedded symmetric positive semi-definite machine-learned elements for reduced-order modeling; Convex Neural Energy Elements - SPSD-by-construction is necessary for assembled solves; the regularisation-nullspace principle behind the rigid projector.

Neural Level Set Topology Optimization Using Unfitted Finite Elements; Linking ghost penalty and aggregated unfitted methods; On the design of locking free ghost penalty stabilization - the documented GP discontinuity and the analytic tools for a continuous-in-geometry stabilisation.

A trust region framework for managing the use of approximation models in optimization; Progressive construction of a parametric reduced-order model for PDE-constrained optimization - trust-region management of a biased surrogate in TO.

Stress-constrained topology optimization of lattice-like structures using component-wise reduced order models - sensitivities ~10x more sensitive than displacements; consistent gradients through the reduced Schur complement.
Spectral bias in physics-informed and operator learning: Analysis and mitigation guidelines - second-order optimisers for the soft-mode fine-tune.
Data Complexity Estimates for Operator Learning - polynomial sample complexity only for regular operator classes; motivates continuous labels and the learning-curve kill.
Principal-Part Decomposition for Neural Operator Learning of Dirichlet-to-Neumann Maps - the fallback branch (computed principal part + learned residual).

# H2-SQRT: an O_h-equivariant hierarchical (H2) square-root neural operator for the TPMS interface Schur complement

## 1. Thesis and representation

The only representation that has passed the +-3% gate on the real teacher is hierarchical low rank: an H-approximation of the reference factor R* at 12.23M numbers (14.95% of dense) on seat 0328 and 13.9-15.6% on four seats, built on a bisection tree (leaf 64, 1344 near-field + 2965 admissible blocks, admissibility min(diam) <= 2 dist) with no fitting [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]. It also has a theoretical licence (H-Cholesky factors exist with exponential convergence in rank; Schur-complement off-diagonal blocks have bounded rank) and network templates (MNN-H2, Neural-HSS). This path makes that object the learned output, with four changes forced by the measured facts.

(i) Output is a symmetric square root, not a Cholesky factor. Rhat is a symmetric H2-matrix on the full trace (q dofs; fixed background-grid octree over the six faces, leaf 64, the admissibility that passed). Shat = Z Rhat^2 Z, Z the orthogonal projector onto the complement of the six rigid modes. Consequences: PSD for every Rhat (x^T Rhat^2 x = ||Rhat x||^2); rigid null space exact by construction (the diagonal-only attractor at 38.8% was cured only by rigid invariance by construction [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]); exact cube-group equivariance is possible because the label A^{1/2} is the unique SPD square root, canonical, gauge-free, continuous and P_g-equivariant, whereas a Cholesky factor needs a node ordering that no permutation group preserves. Error model: Rhat = A^{1/2} + F gives whitened M = (I+Delta)(I+Delta^T), Delta = A^{-1/2}F, eps_op ~ 2||Delta||: left-multiplicative error unamplified, additive factor error amplified by at most sqrt(cond) = 269 (111 measured for entry-relative noise), never by cond(A) = 7.2e4 [METRIC][ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS]. Evaluation stays on the quotient, Ahat = B Shat B^T, with the existing evaluator.

(ii) Fixed ranks per level with nested bases. A far-field block at level l is U_s C_st U_t^T with cluster bases U_s (n_s x r_l) nested through transfer matrices (H2: O(N r) basis storage) and r_l fixed a priori from the Stage-0 oracle (top-8 singular values carry >= 99.5% of far face-face block energy, the adaptive average at +-3% was ~18 per block; shared bases need 2-3x that, so r_l = 32 at the leaf level falling to 16 at the top is the working assumption) [STRUCTURE OF S]. The leading six columns of every U_s are the cluster's analytic rigid-body modes (Saint-Venant resultants): fixed, geometry-computable, gauge-free. Symmetry: C_ts = C_st^T.

(iii) Precision by gauge, not magnitude. Every emitted number is O(1) in a multiplicative gauge, Rhat_ij = exp((s_i+s_j)/2) r_ij, with s the per-dof log compliance scale that is predictable from local geometry (R^2 0.98 within a cell, leave-one-seat-out spread 16.8) [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]. The 6x6 rigid-rigid sub-block of every coupling C_st is emitted by a separate high-precision residual head, because the cancellation analysis says the smooth leading far-field components must cohere with the near field to ~1e-4 on the factor while tails may be loose at ~1e-2; the near/far cancellation of ratio 1e3-1e4 is what banding cannot survive [STRUCTURE OF S].

(iv) Supervision only on gauge-free objects: block products, actions, and the whitened spectrum; never SVD coefficients [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a].

Budget: <= 20% of dense per cell (~16M numbers, ~130 MB fp64 at d = 12,792): near-field dense ~5.5M, bases ~0.5-1M, couplings ~1-7M depending on r_l, the rest margin. Variable q (3k-47.8k) is handled by a deterministic leaf-merging rule on the exact active mask.

## 2. Teacher and data

Teacher: the frozen CutFEM Q2 GP pipeline, but labels are made continuous before any generalisation claim. A +0.01% thickness change stiffens one 1.1e-6 direction by 59.8% through a 5.6e-15 volume-fraction cell and three new GP faces; operator central differences disagree by 87%; the hard-classifier prototype flips to mu_max 1.25 on a 1e-12 threshold shift [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]. A directly learned boundary operator is a continuous function of its inputs; against these labels it cannot pass +-3% in any neighbourhood of an event, and events are ~1e-4 apart in relative thickness. Stage 1 therefore regenerates all labels with a C1-blended aggregation stabilisation: aggregation/ghost weights beta(v) = beta0 (1 - w(v)) with w a C1 ramp in the cut-cell volume fraction on [0, v0], island components deleted, face penalties scaled by w(v_min) of the two cells. Every term is PSD, preserving Loewner monotonicity. Acceptance of the new teacher: Tet10 compliance agreement stays within 0.05-0.10% [ASSEMBLY / DELIVERABLE]; whitened central differences at h = 1e-4 and 1e-3 agree to O(h^2); no direction below the FP64 floor (storage-floor tool [TOOLS AVAILABLE]); the ~6 fragment modes gone. Cost ~1024 x 31.85 s on 64 cores ~ 9 h. The exact discrete state (active-cell mask, GP-face graph, volume fractions, support measures) is always a network input, so the remaining C0 kinks at vertex crossings are representable.

Labels: A^{1/2} by fp64 eigendecomposition (2e12 flops, tens of seconds on a GPU) for all 1024 packets (only 33 are factored today; the bottleneck is self-imposed [GOAL]), plus L* = chol(A) for whitening, stored fp32 and streamed; H2-projected block labels of A^{1/2} on the fixed tree; the rigid-rigid coupling labels P_s^T A^{1/2}_st P_t are unique and continuous. Volume: 1024 -> 8192 geometries (teacher 31.85 s/cell: ~3 days on 64 cores) sampled to cover the TO design range of the 8+4 parameters, plus 256 CUT-through-boundary seats (none exist [GOAL]). The 48 cube-group images are exact [GOAL] and are used as training frames and as an equivariance test. Splits are registered; the holdout is never used for screening.

## 3. Architecture

Encoder: 3D U-Net on the 65^3 grid (11 analytic fields, level-set gradient, active-cell and GP-face masks, volume fraction, support measure, node mask; five levels, 32 -> 256 channels; attention over the 5^3 coarsest grid for global mixing, because the coupling of opposite faces through the sheet is global and V1's receptive radius 0.23 could not represent a 1e3-1e4 cancellation [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]); ~5M parameters; bf16 trunk. Exact O_h-equivariance by frame averaging, Rhat = (1/48) sum_g P_g^T Rhat_theta(g.geom) P_g (an average of symmetric matrices, so Ahat stays PSD): four random frames per training step, all 48 batched at inference. A steerable group-convolution encoder is a later efficiency upgrade.

Node and cluster features: gathered at trace nodes (phi_i in R^96); cluster features at every octree level by attention pooling over active nodes; one global context vector.

Heads, all weight-shared, all emitting O(1) numbers in the scaled gauge: scale head s_i (pretrained on the compliance regression); near-field head, 3x3 blocks per node pair inside the near-field leaf pairs from (phi_i, phi_j, x_i - x_j, face normals), symmetric by construction; basis head, U_s = qr+([rigid modes | MLP(phi) columns]) with positive-diagonal QR fixing the gauge, plus transfer matrices between levels; coupling head, C_st from (pooled features of s and t, relative position and orientation, global context), with the rigid-rigid 6x6 sub-block from the high-precision residual head; optional soft-subspace head (Stage 5), Rhat <- Rhat + W E W^T with k = 256 predicted directions and a symmetric E, two-sided by construction (the old rank-512 M could only soften and its L's had lambda_min(H0) 0.02-0.13 [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED c]).

Assembly in fp64: an H2-matvec costs ~3e7 flops; Ahat is never formed except for audits.

## 4. Loss and training

Every training signal is a function of Ahat's action on a labelled seat, whitened by L*. Bulk: whitened Frobenius (1/d)||M - I||_F^2, M = L*^{-1} Ahat L*^{-T}, by Hutchinson with 32 probes enriched by the seat's 64 softest eigenvectors (guarantees hold only in probed directions). It upper-bounds eps_op, conservatively by at most sqrt(d) = 113; D/d is a diagnostic only, since it misleads by ~100x (1.27e-5 vs eps_op 0.229, three deciding modes) [METRIC]. Tail: a two-sided log-symmetric hinge sum max(0, |log mu_k| - log(1+eps))^2 over the 32 lowest and 32 highest Ritz values of M from warm-started block Lanczos (two iterations per step, full restart every 100 steps), Ritz vectors detached, gradients by Hellmann-Feynman through one H2-matvec per mode; curriculum eps 0.5 -> 0.3 -> 0.1 -> 0.03. Two-sided because a one-sided term traded mu_max 15 -> 5 for mu_min 0.13 -> 0.05 [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]. Certified monitor: a Schatten-32 Hutchinson estimate (<= 1.34 ||M - I||_2) every 20 steps; exact fp64 eigendecomposition on dev seats every epoch is the only number reported as eps_op. Pretraining, local and gauge-free: near-field blocks and far-field products U C U^T against the H2-projected blocks of A^{1/2}, entries scaled by exp(-(s_i+s_j)/2), nested Eckart-Young ordering of the learned basis columns. Optimiser: AdamW (bf16 trunk, fp32 heads, fp64 assembly, whitening and Lanczos), then a Gauss-Newton/K-FAC fine-tune of the heads, because Newton with column scaling converged where raw Adam produced NaNs [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b] and spectral bias is largely an optimisation phenomenon. Cost ~1 s per (seat, frame) step; a full run on 1024 seats ~20-30 GPU-days.

## 5. Acceptance and deployment

Contract: module-level Loewner sandwich, eps_op = max|mu - 1| <= 0.10 (work) / 0.03 (target) on held-out seats, reported with the number of modes outside each gate and their physical/stabilisation classification. It composes exactly: (1-eps)S_c <= Shat_c <= (1+eps)S_c for all cells gives (1-eps)K <= Khat <= (1+eps)K for any lattice, compliance within ~+-eps and energy-norm displacement error <= eps/(1-eps); the 0.31% compliance error at eps_op 0.152 was alignment luck and is not relied on [ASSEMBLY / DELIVERABLE]. If the Stage-0 gamma sweep shows the deciding modes are stabilisation-defined, the contract is registered as a shifted-whitening sandwich (A + cE) with c fixed by the sweep [OPEN DECISIONS 1]. Secondary registered task suite: heterogeneous 2-cell, 2x2x2 and 4x4x4 assemblies, non-self-equilibrated loads, compliance, energy-norm displacement, and finite-difference end-load compliance sensitivities against the teacher's stable derivative (0.023%), with sensitivities expected ~10x more sensitive than compliance.

Deployment is mode A [OPEN DECISIONS 2]: Shat = Z Rhat^2 Z in H2 form (~130 MB fp64 per cell, <= 1 s on one GPU including 48 frames, against 31.85 s x 64 cores), assembled by cell actions and solved by PCG; the TO loop is trust-region managed, with teacher evaluations on a sparse subset of cells every k iterations restoring first-order consistency, the only convergence guarantee available for a biased surrogate. No inference-time interior solve is used on the primary path [OPEN DECISIONS 3]. Mode B is kept only as a diagnostic (PCG iteration count on a lattice is a cheap monotone proxy of eps_op); its true-action cost is the elimination being avoided.

## 6. Staged plan

Stage 0, oracle and label audit (2 weeks; ~25 teacher runs, ~15 min on 64 cores; 2 GPU-days). (a) H2 oracle of A^{1/2} with fixed per-level ranks and the fixed octree on the 4 factored seats plus 12 newly factored ones. Outcome: +-3% at <= 20% of dense and +-10% at <= 15%. (b) Coherence oracle: perturb the passing factor's near field, far-field rigid-rigid couplings and far-field tails by independent smooth relative fields at 1e-2, 1e-3, 1e-4. Outcome: precision budgets b_near, b_lead, b_tail for eps_op <= 0.10 and <= 0.03. (c) Gamma sweep on 0328 (1e-3, 1e-5) and the thickness-exponent test (uniform tau scaling: membrane modes at 1+delta, bending at (1+delta)^3): which modes decide, and are they physics. (d) Interpolability: nine teacher runs along the thickness path at spacings 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1; eps_op of the endpoint-averaged factor at midpoints; activation events counted. (e) Factor all 1024 packets; cross-seat Thompson distances in the common trace ordering.

Stage 1, continuous labels (2 weeks; 9 h x 64 cores per 1024 geometries). Outcome: Tet10 within 0.10%, whitened central differences agree to O(h^2), the ideal interpolant at spacing 1e-2 passes +-10%. Then regenerate 1024, extend to 8192, add 256 CUT seats.

Stage 2, fit without geometry (3 GPU-days). Free H2 parameters on 0328 trained with the bulk + tail loss from the oracle truncation and from a scaled random start. Outcome: <= 0.03 held from the oracle start, <= 0.10 from scratch within 5k steps; this also settles whether the Newton dense fit's 0.047 was a loss ceiling [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b], and yields the residual model of a fitted H2 factor.

Stage 3, one-seat neural memorisation (2 weeks). Full network on 0328 x 48 frames. Outcome: train eps_op <= 0.10, the first neural pass on any seat (the best so far is ~4 and V1 did not memorise its own training seats [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]); the measured residual (entry-relative, block-coherent or soft-aligned) replaces the 100x uncertainty in the precision budget [ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS].

Stage 4, generalisation and learning curve (6 weeks; ~30 GPU-days). Train on 24 / 768 / 6144 seats with dev sets of 8 / 128 / 512. Outcome: dev eps_op <= 0.3 at 33, <= 0.10 at 1024, <= 0.03 at 8192, with a decreasing curve. Ablations: frame averaging vs augmentation; analytic vs learned leading bases; enriched vs plain probes.

Stage 5, soft-subspace head (2 weeks). Outcome: modes outside +-3% on dev <= 10 and dev eps_op improved >= 2x; otherwise dropped.

Stage 6, assembly, sensitivities, TO (3 weeks). Heterogeneous lattices (never tested, even for the teacher [ASSEMBLY / DELIVERABLE]), adjoint and finite-difference sensitivities, a trust-region mini-TO on a 4x4x4 lattice against a teacher run. Outcome: sensitivity error <= 3x the Loewner compliance bound and the same primary load paths.

Stage 7, CUT cells, throughput, release (4 weeks). 256 CUT seats trained and evaluated; inference <= 1 s per cell; certificate tool shipped.

Fallback branch, outside the prior, triggered by K2 or K6: a principal-part design in which a coarse interior model (fine collar plus a shell-kinematic or Q2 core, 1-3 s per cell) supplies the leading far-field couplings exactly and the same H2 network learns only a multiplicative correction (I + Delta); encoder, loss, contract and data carry over unchanged.

## 7. Kill criteria

K1: Stage 0a needs > 30% of dense for +-3% or cannot pass +-10% at any budget. K2: Stage 0b gives b_lead < 1e-4 for +-10% (leading couplings must be better than 1e-4 relative). K3: no continuous stabilisation keeps Tet10 within 0.10% and the whitened Lipschitz constant below ~10 per unit relative thickness; the module contract is then unattainable by any continuous surrogate and the programme moves to a task-level or floored contract. K4: Stage 2 cannot hold 0.03 from the oracle start or reach 0.10 from scratch. K5: Stage 3 cannot memorise one seat to 0.3. K6: the Stage-4 dev curve is flat between 33 and 1024 seats, or exceeds 0.3 at 1024, or exceeds 0.10 at 8192. K7: Stage 6 sensitivity error > 10x the compliance bound, or the mini-TO diverges from the teacher's design at +-10% modules. K8: inference slower than the teacher's 31.85 s wall-clock or storage > 300 MB per cell.

## 8. What is discarded and what is kept

Discarded from the critical path: the banded-L + low-rank-M backend (`superelement/neural_schur/backend.py`, `fit.py`) and its fixed-L reachability criterion (`factor_fit/reachability.py`); the T^T D T lifting layers, their closed-form block-diagonal oracle and lifting inverse and the 22x sparse gradient (`neural_schur/oracle.py`, `test_lift.py`), all reachability-limited by 37-600x [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED c,d]; the V1/V1G six-face CNN (`v1_superelement.py`, `run_v1*.sh`); the free dense-factor Newton fit as a model (`factor_fit/step1_*.py`, kept as a diagnostic); the collar + coarse-core pipeline as the primary path (retained as the fallback's principal part); the current GP labels; the 33-factor limit; the Cholesky factor on the quotient as the learned object (the quotient B is kept for evaluation). Kept and reused: the full-spectrum evaluator (`neural_schur/evaluator.py`, `spectrum_eval.py`), the hierarchical builder with self-tests (`factor_fit/hmat*.py`, `multiseat.py`) as oracle and block-label projector, the assembly harness (`factor_fit/assemble*.py`), the storage-floor and mode-classification tools, the per-entry noise and coherence scripts (`perentry.py`, `coher.py`), the compliance-scale regression (`step2_quotient_scale.py`), the teacher rebuild (`gp_build.py`, `gp_launch.py`) and the cube-group code.

## 9. Key risks

1. Precision: ~1e5 smooth global coupling numbers per cell at ~1e-4 relative, 10-100x beyond demonstrated operator-learning precision; mitigated by the Stage-0 budget, analytic leading bases, 8192 geometries and the learning-curve kill. 2. H2-compressibility of A^{1/2} is unmeasured (R* costs 15%); fallback is an H-Cholesky in octree post-order with per-frame labels. 3. If label regeneration is refused, no continuous surrogate can pass the module gate [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]. 4. Tail-loss dynamics (spectral whack-a-mole, Lanczos missing new outliers); mitigated by the Schatten monitor, restarts and exact audits. 5. Data density: ~3 samples per geometry axis at 1024 seats; the effective dimension of the coupling map is unknown. 6. Physical validity of the softest modes is untested beyond compliance (gamma-dependence). 7. fp64 throughput and streaming 1024 whitening factors. 8. Frame averaging costs 48 encoder passes; sparse active clusters at small q. 9. Compliance is first order in the operator error and sensitivities are untested; TO can exploit surrogate error, hence the trust region. 10. No CUT labels exist today.
